fields.label: Legacy Title
fields.name: about_legacy_title
fields.default_value: Driven by a Legacy of Education

fields.label: Legacy Paragraph 1
fields.name: about_legacy_p1
fields.default_value: True instructional leadership isn't born in a vacuum; it is forged through years of real-world classroom experience and a deep respect for the teaching profession. As the daughter of dedicated lifelong educators, my path was set early. I witnessed firsthand the profound impact that a supported, highly skilled teacher can have on a student’s life.

fields.label: Legacy Paragraph 2
fields.name: about_legacy_p2
fields.default_value: Today, with over 20 years of cross-curricular experience spanning elementary, secondary, and collegiate levels, I carry that legacy forward. I know the unique pressures secondary teachers face—balancing heavy content pacing, evolving state standards, and diverse classroom reading dynamics. My mission through In Context Learning Solutions is to ensure that educators never have to navigate these challenges alone.
